content.comment_body: I realized the hard way that my existing configuration with the [product_name] (AM2 RTD, [article_no]) cannot be upgraded with the newer module ([article_no]) due to incompatibility. Unfortunately, the AM2 [article_no] series expansion modules can't be used with the newer [article_no] module; you need AM2 modules from the [article_no] series. The physical connectors prevent this connection, which was disappointing. If only I had known earlier... As a workaround, is it possible to use a [article_no] series expansion module as an intermediate connection between the main [article_no] module and the older AM2 RTD ([article_no])? That is: [article_no] - DM8 24 ([article_no]) - AM2 RTD ([article_no]). Can [article_no] expansion modules accept [article_no] modules on their right side? Any suggestions?

The [product_name] Series 8 introduces completely new software and hardware, resulting in total incompatibility with previous versions. There are no adapters to bridge the difference. [company_name] made this information available from the beginning in their publications.
Attached is a screenshot from the [company_name] website.

From my experience, I found out after purchasing the [article_no] that the incompatibility was not clearly stated in any documentation I read beforehand. Even the manual only covers compatibility, not incompatibility. I understand that highlighting compatibility sounds better, but clear information on non-compatibility is important and I believe [company_name] should have been more transparent. The image shared earlier is the first explicit source I've seen regarding this incompatibility. In any case, now I know. As a follow-up—does anyone know if [article_no] series expansion modules are also incompatible with [article_no] modules?

I can say with certainty: I've known about this since the beginning and understood the incompatibility. To my knowledge, it's not possible to mix older ([article_no] to [article_no]) and newer ([article_no]) modules. The bus system in the [article_no] modules is different. For reference, here's a link to the [company_name] website: [url] (entry date: 08/29/2014)

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered unexpected compatibility problems when trying to connect an older [product_name] ([article_no]) expansion module with a newer [product_name] ([article_no]) module. Differences in hardware—such as physical connectors and bus communication—make it impossible to link modules from different generations. The main source of user frustration is the insufficiently clear communication from [company_name] about these limitations in product documentation and before purchase.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expected either forward compatibility or explicit warnings about incompatibility between generations of hardware modules before making a purchase. They also hoped for some workaround to avoid having to replace older expansion modules.
